name: Sonnet price momentum
strategy: Concentrate in the strongest 12-month price-momentum themes (AI infrastructure/semis, mega-cap tech, and newly-broadening small caps) via leveraged long ETFs and leaders, while shorting the clearest negative-momentum trends (AI-disruption software laggards and the crypto bear market) to stay style-true without chasing an overextended single sector.

positions.thesis: 3x Nasdaq-100 captures the still-dominant AI/mega-cap tech momentum leg (QQQ +17.3% H1) with the cleanest, most liquid leveraged exposure to the theme.
Semis remain the strongest 12mo momentum theme (SOXL +250% H1) despite the last-month correction; sizing below max to respect the pullback while staying concentrated in the leading theme.
Small caps are newly catching a momentum bid (+19.4% H1) as breadth improves beyond mega-cap tech, a fresh leadership rotation worth riding unlevered given breadth risk.
Memory/AI-infra single name with standout 12mo momentum (+187% H1); direct exposure to the AI capex cycle underpinning the semis leg.
Core AI-compute momentum name (+137% H1) riding the same infrastructure buildout as MU/SOXL, diversifying single-stock risk within the theme.
Software incumbents are the clearest negative-momentum theme (-49% H1) on AI-disruption fear; shorting the trend rather than fighting it.
Crypto is in a deep, persistent 12mo downtrend (BTC -27% H1); a modest leveraged short rides that momentum while capping liquidation risk at 3x.

outlook: AI-infra momentum names are digesting a huge H1 run but remain the dominant uptrend; small caps are broadening the rally while crypto stays in a structural downtrend, so I'm leaning long leveraged equity momentum, short the weakest AI-disruption laggards and BTC.
